name: interface-asserted-by-an-outside-callee
description: A value passed as an argument to a function a package outside the program declares is held by that function through its parameter, so a method by which the value's type implements an interface the source of the callee's package asserts is retained: net/http/httptest asserts io.ReadCloser on the io.Reader it is given, which keeps Close. A Close method of a value handed only to a callee whose package's source asserts no interface that Close helps satisfy stays reported. An exported field of a value passed to such a parameter is not read on that account, because only an empty-interface parameter hands the value to code that may read its fields.
